history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young person with dark hair styled in a high ponytail, wearing glasses, stands in front of a wooden-paneled wall and a glass door. They are holding a takeaway coffee cup with a straw in their right hand and are looking down at it. The person is dressed in a light blue denim jacket, a white t-shirt, black trousers, and white sneakers with blue accents. A white crossbody bag is slung over their left shoulder.

On the glass door, white text reads "COFFEE PASTRY SOCIAL 24/7" with a circular logo incorporating a clock and a coffee cup. Below this, smaller text says "SLEEP IS OPTIONAL SOCIAL ISN'T". The lighting is natural, casting soft shadows and highlighting the textures of the wood and denim. The overall color palette is warm, with the browns of the wood contrasting with the blues and whites of the person's attire and the drink. The mood is casual and relaxed, suggesting a moment of pause outside a cafe. The perspective is eye-level, capturing the person from the waist up, with the background slightly blurred.
